name: ConvertlyAI
tagline: ConvertlyAI is a text-based SaaS platform operating as a context-aware content repurposing engine
description: ConvertlyAI is a text-based SaaS platform operating as a context-aware content repurposing engine. Designed for solo founders, creators, and bootstrapped entrepreneurs, the platform transforms a single input—such as a rough draft, voice note, or video transcript—into a comprehensive suite of distinct marketing assets instantly. By eliminating prompt fatigue and the need for repetitive context setting, ConvertlyAI allows users to scale their brand voice across blogs, newsletters, and social media
